correctness.rationale: For uniform spanning tree indicators on K_{a,b}, a,b>=2, the known Burton–Pemantle transfer-current kernel is K=B^T L^+B, explicitly K_{(i,j),(k,l)}=[i=k]/b+[j=l]/a−1/(ab). Determinantal pair inclusion gives offdiagonal Cov(Xe,Xf)=−Kef² and diagonal p(1−p), p=(a+b−1)/(ab). By row/column permutation invariance and direct projector substitution the covariance is exactly ((b−1)/(ab)) P_R + ((a−1)/(ab)) P_C + ((a+b−3)/(ab)) P_H, with constant kernel and dimensions a−1,b−1,(a−1)(b−1). Taking the quadratic form yields the stated variance decomposition, extremal spectral bounds, and best *affine degree-based* prediction residual in interaction component. Independent exact enumeration of 529 trees across sizes 2x2,2x3,3x3,3x4 and rational covariance diagonalization matched all eigenvalues and multiplicities. The infinite parameter theorem rests on kernel/projector identities, not the small graphs.
